newsitem.title: FRANCE: French hospital workers march, doctors strike.
newsitem.headline: French hospital workers march, doctors strike.

text.p: Thousands of hospital workers marched through Paris on Friday protesting against budget curbs while junior hospital doctors went on strike fearful that social security reforms will cut their earnings.
Unions said some 5,000 hospital workers took part in the protest, about double the number estimated by police.
The protesters said budget restrictions meant less equipment for hospitals and increasingly difficult working conditions.

The junior doctors, recent graduates of medical schools training in hospitals, are protesting against new government-set rules aimed at limiting medical spending by the country's comprehensive but hugely indebted social security system.

The young doctors say the rules will result in their future earnings being capped to unacceptably low levels. Their unions say about 80 percent of the 7,500 doctors falling into their category are on strike.
Several of the strikers applied plaster casts to 100 parking meters in the northern city of Lille as part of their protests.
